0022600018.text: The Knicks (2-3, eighth in the East and fourth in the Atlantic, two games back) visit the 76ers (4-1, first in the Atlantic and second in the East) in the sixth game of New York's season, an Emirates NBA Cup East Group B matchup, with the Knicks on a two-game win streak and Philadelphia on a one-game streak. For New York, Jose Alvarado is out with an ankle sprain and Karl-Anthony Towns is day-to-day, while Philadelphia is without Ariel Hukporti (Achilles, surgery), Dominick Barlow (back fracture), Jabari Walker (knee soreness), Jaylen Brown (knee) and Tacko Fall (quadriceps strain). The Knicks trail the 2026-27 season series 0-1 after a 106-100 loss in New York on October 20, the teams split 2-2 in 2025-26, and the Knicks won 4-0 in the 2025-26 playoffs.
